messages:
maria (PM): FYI — Acme Health reached out. They want us to serve Paloma-14B for clinical note summarization in a HIPAA environment. Asking for SLA ~100ms p95 at 1rps/user, private deployment (VPC). Can we triage?
lee (ML Eng): link to model artifacts? weights, tokenizer, format?
maria (PM): https://s3.acme/prod/paloma-14b/v1/model.tar.gz
They also sent a sample prompt set (20k tokens total) and an evaluation rubric. Customer wants low hallucination on meds/diagnoses. They flagged cost sensitivity.
sam (Quant Eng): TL;DR: 14B likely fits in 4 A40-ish hosts with int8; baseline fp16 to measure perf/quality. Plan: 1) fp16 smoke, 2) PTQ/int8 with per-channel, 3) run evals. Any forbidden ops (like group attention)?
lee (ML Eng): Quick smoke: run inference with seq_len=1024, batch=1. Can someone run perf on a dedicated g4dn? example command:
```
redwood run --model /tmp/paloma-14b --dtype fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --measure
```
Will check tokenization differences.
jordan (SRE): We can allocate a private staging VPC. Need expected RAM+GPU mem. What's ckpt size?
sam (Quant Eng): Model tar is 28GB fp16 on disk. After sharding and quant it should drop to ~9-12GB. KV cache at 1024 adds ~2.4GB per GPU. So recommend 48GB GPU for safe float16 baseline (p4d/p40), or int8 on 24-40GB cards.
olivia (Security): HIPAA checklist: ensure KMS for keys, audit logs retention 365d, disable external telemetry. We'll need a security intake form from Acme.
maria (PM): Action items: lee run fp16 smoke + eval subset; sam run PTQ experiments; jordan provision staging VPC; olivia prod security checklist request. Can we set target timeline? customer wants staging by next Tue.
lee (ML Eng): I can do fp16 smoke today, run 100 sample prompts from their set. Will post results.
sam (Quant Eng): I'll try LLM.int8() pipeline. Expect some quality drop, will run hallucination checks and rouge/precision metrics. If too bad, try q4_0 or 4-bit adaptive.
jordan (SRE): Provisioning started — ETA ~8 hours. tagging: acme-paloma-staging. Will post the instance IDs.
deploy-bot: checklist created: onboarding:security_form|staging_vpc|smoke_fp16|ptq_int8|eval_report
maria (PM): Prioritization: P1 because it's a paying customer with compliance needs. We'll escalate if any blockers.
lee (ML Eng): Quick note — tokenizer uses custom added tokens for meds. Need to run tokenizer tests. Might need tokenizer.json alongside model.
sam (Quant Eng): If tokenizer mismatch, quant tools might fail. Lee please confirm tokenizers match.
lee (ML Eng): Confirmed — tokenizer in tar. Will validate.
olivia (Security): Also require SOC2 customer contacts and BAAs. I'll reach out to legal.
maria (PM): Great. I'll create a short PRD in Confluence with timeline and acceptance criteria (latency, hallucination thresholds, cost target).
lee (ML Eng): Posting initial smoke results in this thread once done.
sam (Quant Eng): I'll tag bench numbers and a brief runbook for fallback to smaller model if we can't meet p95.
jordan (SRE): Instances up: i-0a1b2c3d4e5 (staging GPU), subnet private. SSH for team via bastion.
lee (ML Eng): Smoke done: fp16 baseline 160ms p95, 1.8 tokens/ms throughput, no crashes. Sample lesion/hallucination metric: 0.9 precision (on small set). Uploading logs: s3://redwood-staging/acme/paloma/smoke-3632109999.log
sam (Quant Eng): PTQ run1 (per-channel int8): p95 120ms, hallucination regression +3.2% vs baseline — acceptable? I'll try q4_0 next.
maria (PM): Customer sensitivity on hallucination: anything >2% regression requires human-in-loop or revert. Sam, can you try q4_0 and a small calibration set?
sam (Quant Eng): Will do. Also trying layerwise outlier clipping.
olivia (Security): Legal has the BAA draft. Maria, forwarding to Acme today.
maria (PM): Thanks. Next check-in tomorrow 10am PT. If any blocker, @maria (PM) ping.
